new_libraries.name: MoleGraphManual
new_libraries.author: e-Mole
new_libraries.sentence: Callback-based library for custom programming of the MoleGraph school probeware system and using its multiplatform app.
new_libraries.paragraph: MoleGraphManual allows you to develop custom probeware firmware for Arduino NANO/UNO (ATmega 328P) with simultaneous data transmission, control external actuators, and display measurement data with MoleGraph applications (app project: https://www.molegraph.eu). It perfectly integrates with Blockly@rduino for visual programming and is optimized for advanced experimental designs.
